title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.0, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, a user who holds the "power" Splunk…
description: Splunk Enterprise versions prior to 10.6.0, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 contain a vulnerability where users with the "power" role can inject attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) into shared data model calculations. When other users run searches against these shared data models, the injected SPL executes with their permissions, potentially exposing sensitive credentials. This occurs because Splunk does not properly neutralize data model calculation fields before including them in generated searches.
